nodes_list: Meshy - Text to 3D (Preview), Meshy - Text to 3D (Refine), Meshy - Image to 3D

name: ComfyUI-Hunyuan3D-v3
description: This package enables text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation using Tencent Cloud's Hunyuan 3D Global API, supporting PBR materials, face count control, and output in GLB format.

name: ComfyUI-TextureAlchemy
description: Transforms images into PBR material sets with AI-powered texture extraction for game engines and 3D software, including albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, AO, height, and curvature maps.
nodes_list: PBR Extractor (Marigold), Normal Map Processor, Material Mixer, Channel Packer, Texture Tiler

name: ComfyUI-NormalsToDepth
description: This package converts normal maps to depth maps, which are essential for 3D workflows involving depth estimation and 3D reconstruction.
